## Dependencies

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(ggplot2)
   #remotes::install_github("Jiayi-Wang-Joey/weightedMotifAccess")

## Spearman's correlation

```{r}
se <- readRDS("/mnt/plger/jwang/Cusanovich/counts_HS.rds")
mtx <- as.matrix(counts(se))
cor_mat <- cor(mtx, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
dt <- as.data.table(as.table(cor_mat))
```

## MA plot

### Origin counts
```{r}
samps <- c(Fixed.37C = "SRX10861478.GSM5290898", Fixed.55C = "SRX10861481.GSM5290901",
           Native.37C = "SRX10861426.GSM5290846", Native.55C = "SRX10861421.GSM5290841")
se <- readRDS("/mnt/germain/datasets/CusanovichATACprotocols/mergedPeaks_SE2.rds")
sra <- read.delim("/mnt/germain/datasets/CusanovichATACprotocols/SraRunTable.txt", sep=",")
md <- fread("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE174nnn/GSE174280/matrix/GSE174280-GPL21697_series_matrix.txt.gz", skip = 39)
md <- setNames(gsub("-Rep[0-9]+","",colnames(md)[-1]), md[1,-1])
sra$name <- md[sra$GEO_Accession..exp.]
md <- as.data.frame(t(sapply(strsplit(sra$name, "-"), \(x) x[c(2,4:6)])))
colnames(md) <- c("Nuclei", "Buffer", "Temperature", "Tn5")
sra <- cbind(sra, md)
row.names(sra) <- paste(sra$Experiment, sra$GEO_Accession..exp., sep=".")
colData(se) <- DataFrame(sra[colnames(se),c("Bases",colnames(md))])

dd <- data.frame(M=rowMeans(assay(se)),
      A=log1p(assay(se)[,samps[4]])-log1p(assay(se)[,samps[3]]), 
      type = "origin")

cd <- colData(se)
pk <- cd[cd$Nuclei=="Native" & cd$Tn5 =="Nextera_Tn5" & cd$Buffer != "Nextera_TD",]
```


### Weighted counts
```{r}
bams <- list.files("/mnt/plger/datasets/CusanovichATACprotocols/aligned", 
    pattern = "\\.bam$",
    full.names = TRUE)
sample <- vapply(bams, \(x) {
    name <- basename(x)
    sub("\\.bam$", "", name)
}, character(1))
names(bams) <- sample
bams <-  bams[rownames(pk)]
atacFrags <- .importFragments(as.list(bams))

peaks <- import.bed(con="/mnt/plger/datasets/CusanovichATACprotocols/peaks/merged.bed")
se2 <- weightedMotifAccess::getCounts(atacFrag = atacFrags, ranges = peaks,
                    genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
                    species = "Homo sapiens",
                    fragWeight=TRUE, peakWeight=TRUE)

dd2 <- data.frame(M=rowMeans(assay(se2)),
    A=log1p(assay(se2)[,samps[4]])-log1p(assay(se2)[,samps[3]]),
    type = "weights")
    

p2
dd2$type <- "weights"
dd$type <- "origin"
dt <- rbind(dd2, dd)
p2 <- ggplot(dt, aes(M, A)) + geom_hex(bins=c(70,15)) + scale_x_log10(limits=c(1,1000)) +
    geom_smooth(method="gam") + scale_fill_gradient(low="lightgrey", high="darkred") + 
    labs(x="Mean accessibility", y="Log-foldchange", title="Native.55C vs Native.37C") + 
    facet_wrap(~type, nrow=1, scale="free_y") + theme_bw()  

ggsave("plts/cusanovich_MA.pdf", p2, width = 24, height = 7, unit = "cm")
```
